The '''South Ridge Beach''' was a beach located on the [[Sky Ridge Island]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The South Ridge Beach appears as an area on Rishi in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
